title: Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference Guest Speech Review p03 Sherry Analysis of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025 & Case Sharing
description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

In this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game production and virtual creation. From the collaborative growth between Marvelous Designer and its users to the shocking release of new features in 2025, the presentations covered practical tips for game character costume design and specifically explained how Marvelous Designer interacts with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing.

Don’t miss out on these fantastic insights!
